subject: general
question: A Data-Driven Research, has been launched by the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology on 24 March 2022 with the objective to eradicate which disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuberculosis**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Data-Driven Research initiative launched by the **Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology** on **March 24, 2022**, focuses on eradicating Tuberculosis (TB).
 
• **World TB Day**: The initiative was announced on World TB Day, which is observed on March 24 each year.
 
• **Global Health Concern TB **is a significant public health issue in India, accounting for a substantial number of TB cases worldwide.
 
• The primary objective of the initiative is to **eradicate TB **in India by utilizing a data-driven approach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AIDS** is caused by HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus), which attacks the immune system, specifically CD4 cells (T cells).
 
• **HIV** is transmitted through blood, semen, vaginal fluids, rectal fluids, and breast milk.
 
• **COVID-19** is caused by the **SARS-CoV-2 virus**, a novel coronavirus that emerged in late 2019.
 
• **COVID-19** is diagnosed through RT-PCR tests or rapid antigen tests that detect the presence of the virus.
 
• **Cancer** is a group of diseases characterized by the uncontrolled growth and spread of abnormal cells in the body.
 
• There are many types of cancer, classified based on the tissue or organ affected. **Common types include breast cancer, lung cancer, prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, and skin cancer.**
 
• **Treatment options** vary depending on the type and stage of cancer and may include surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy.
 
• **New treatments, such as CAR-T** cell therapy and personalized medicine, are emerging in oncology.
